title: A linear functional on test forms bounded by B·sup|ω| is a current of mass at most B (supplied fact (F5/F6))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝ^P = Eucl P) be any set, D^n(U) := TestFormOn U n and |γ| := covectorEuclideanNorm γ. Let T₀ : D^n(U) → ℝ be a function and B ∈ ℝ such that T₀(ω + η) = T₀(ω) + T₀(η) and T₀(c·ω) = c·T₀(ω) for all ω, η ∈ D^n(U) and c ∈ ℝ, and |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·C for every ω ∈ D^n(U) and every C ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ C for all y ∈ ℝ^P. Then there is S ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n with S(ω) = T₀(ω) for every ω ∈ D^n(U) and S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T₀ : TestFormOn U n → ℝ) (B : ℝ), (∀ ω η : TestFormOn U n, T₀ (ω + η) = T₀ ω + T₀ η) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), T₀ (c • ω) = c * T₀ ω) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y) ≤ C) → |T₀ ω| ≤ B * C) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω, S ω = T₀ ω) ∧ S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B
